changelog: - **The export-author dialog shows the current session's name.** After switching from a temporary session to this browser, File ▸ Set the export author… opened with empty fields although the browser held a name, and pressing Save without typing deleted that name; after switching to a temporary session it still showed the browser's name. The dialog now reads the stored author each time it opens, so it shows what the current session holds (nothing in a temporary session), an untouched Save changes nothing, and a Save in a temporary session never reaches the browser's record. Text you are typing is never replaced while the dialog is open.
